# gyro_storage_bucket_noncurrent_expiration (Resource)

Old version expiry of a bucket on a Gyro Protected Storage service: non-current versions are deleted `days` after they stop being current (0 = keep them; they count toward the quota). Locked versions are deleted only after their retention ends. New buckets start with 30 days. Destroy sets the bucket back to the default (30 days).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Delete old (non-current) versions 7 days after they are replaced or deleted.
resource "gyro_storage_bucket_noncurrent_expiration" "archive" {
  service_id = gyro_storage_bucket.archive.service_id
  bucket     = gyro_storage_bucket.archive.full_name
  days       = 7
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) Full bucket name (gyro_storage_bucket.<x>.full_name).
- `days` (Number) Days, 1-3650; 0 keeps old versions.
- `service_id` (Number) Protected Storage service id.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_storage_bucket_noncurrent_expiration.archive 789/archive-ab12
```
